verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of New Relic's core platform. The docs describe a SaaS service that agents forward data to, and the self-hostable pieces are only agents, CLIs and diagnostics utilities. One community comment implies New Relic is not on-prem, noting an underserved on-prem APM market where buyable options aren't as good as New Relic.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
